name: Pomodoro
description: Work in focused rounds: ```pomodoro work=25m break=5m``` takes you through work and breaks, with a longer break every few rounds. It shows in the status bar, notifies at each change, and keeps going when its note closes. It runs sandboxed.

notifications.why: Say when it's time for a break, or back to work

embeds.title: Pomodoro
embeds.description: Rounds of work and short breaks, with a long break after every few rounds. Start, pause, skip and reset it in the note.

rounds.description: Work rounds before a long break

id.description: Keeps its state when blocks move or change; leave it as it is
